Author: Anomek, Noir Yamato
Name: NoirMech
Punchline: AnoMech with LPDU strats for TOP P2, P3 and P4, and a pause. Go to an inn and start practice.
Description: A modified version of AnoMech by Anomek (https://github.com/anomek/AnoMech) that adds EU LPDU strats for TOP P2 Party Synergy, TOP P3 Intermission, P3 Hello World, P3 Monitors and P4 Blue Screen, and a pause for studying mechanics mid-run. Spawns fake party members and bosses client-side so you can practice raid mechanics without a full party. Disable AnoMech while using NoirMech. Source: https://github.com/NoirYamato/DalamudPlugins
Changelog: TOP P4 Blue Screen: a new scenario with an [LPDU] Light PF strat under the EU button. Its settings can force or rule out your marker in each set, and whether a set's two markers land in one light party, so someone has to flex.
